Pages link to each other relatively, through `root` (\"\" at\n     7\tthe top of the site, \"../\" one folder down), so the same HTML works served\n     8\tfrom / and exported to a GitHub Pages subfolder. Where each kind of page or\n     9\tfile sits is decided here, by the *_path functions, and nowhere else.\n    10\t\n    11\tContent is read only through the published-only queries (`list_published`,\n    12\t`get_published`), so a draft cannot reach a page, a link, or the navigation.\n    13\t\"\"\"\n    14\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    15\t\n    16\timport sqlite3\n    17\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\n    18\tfrom pathlib import Path\n    19\t\n    20\tfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings\n    21\tfrom app.templating import templates\n    22\t\n    23\tCSS = \"\"\"/* The public site's one stylesheet, at style.css in the site's root. */\n    24\t:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\n    25\tbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\n    26\t.header-home { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }\n    27\t.nav-site ul { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; list-style: none; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; padding: 0; }\n    28\tmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n    29\t/* Markdown tables, in a Data Bite's or Report's body. A wide one scrolls\n    30\t   sideways in its wrapper (app.rendering.TABLE_SCROLL) rather than widening\n    31\t   the page; on a phone, rather than squeezing its text to a word a line. */\n    32\t.content-body .content-table-scroll { margin-block: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; }\n    33\t.content-body table { border-collapse: collapse; }\n    34\t.content-body th, .content-body td { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent); padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; }\n    35\t.content-body th { background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); font-weight: 600; }\n    36\t@media (max-width: 40rem) { .content-body th, .content-body td { min-width: 10ch; } }\n    37\t\"\"\"\n    38\tRECENT_DATA_BITES = 5  # on the home page; the rest are on the Data Bites list\n    39\t\n    40\t\n    41\tdef data_bite_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    42\t    return f\"data-bites/{slug}.html\"\n    43\t\n    44\t\n    45\tdef report_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    46\t    return f\"reports/{slug}.html\"\n    47\t\n    48\t\n    49\tdef report_file_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    50\t    # .pdf, not the upload's own extension: a Report's file is always a PDF (T05).\n    51\t    return f\"reports/files/{slug}.pdf\"\n    52\t\n    53\t\n    54\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n    55\tclass Page:\n    56\t    path: str      # where the page sits in the site, relative to its root\n    57\t    template: str\n    58\t    context: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n    59\t\n    60\t    def render(self) -> str:\n    61\t        root = \"../\" * self.path.count(\"/\")\n    62\t        return templates.env.get_template(self.template).render(\n    63\t            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=root, css_path=f\"{root}style.css\",\n    64\t            home_path=f\"{root}index.html\", nav_reports=reports.list_published(),\n    65\t            data_bite_path=data_bite_path, report_path=report_path,\n    66\t            report_file_path=report_file_path, **self.context)\n    67\t\n    68\t\n    69\tdef home() -> Page:\n    70\t    return Page(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\",\n    71\t                {\"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()[:RECENT_DATA_BITES]})\n    72\t\n    73\t\n    74\tdef data_bite_list() -> Page:\n    75\t    return Page(\"data-bites/index.html\", \"public/data_bites.html\",\n    76\t                {\"page_title\": \"Data Bites\", \"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()})\n    77\t\n    78\t\n    79\tdef data_bite(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    80\t    \"\"\"A published Data Bite's page; None for a draft or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    81\t    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    82\t    return None if bite is None else _data_bite_page(bite)\n    83\t\n    84\t\n    85\tdef _data_bite_page(bite: sqlite3.Row) -> Page:\n    86\t    return Page(data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"]), \"public/data_bite.html\",\n    87\t                {\"page_title\": bite[\"title\"], \"bite\": bite})\n    88\t\n    89\t\n    90\tdef report_list() -> Page:\n    91\t    return Page(\"reports/index.html\", \"public/reports.html\",\n    92\t                {\"page_title\": \"Reports\", \"reports\": reports.list_published()})\n    93\t\n    94\t\n    95\tdef _stored_file(report: sqlite3.Row) -> Path | None:\n    96\t    \"\"\"Where the Report's file is stored, if it has one and it is there.\"\"\"\n    97\t    if report[\"file_name\"] is None:\n    98\t        return None\n    99\t    stored = reports.file_path(report[\"id\"])\n   100\t    return stored if stored.is_file() else None\n   101\t\n   102\t\n   103\tdef report(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n   104\t    \"\"\"A published Report's page, linking its file only if that can be\n   105\t    downloaded; None for a draft or no such Report.\"\"\"\n   106\t    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n   107\t    return None if found is None else _report_page(found)\n   108\t\n   109\t\n   110\tdef _report_page(found: sqlite3.Row) -> Page:\n   111\t    return Page(report_path(found[\"slug\"]), \"public/report.html\",\n   112\t                {\"page_title\": found[\"title\"], \"report\": found,\n   113\t                 \"has_file\": _stored_file(found) is not None})\n   114\t\n   115\t\n   116\tdef report_file(slug: str) -> tuple[Path, str] | None:\n   117\t    \"\"\"A published Report's attached file, at report_file_path(slug) in the\n   118\t    site, as (where it is stored, its display name). None for a draft, a\n   119\t    Report with no file, or no such Report.\"\"\"\n   120\t    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n   121\t    stored = found and _stored_file(found)\n   122\t    return (stored, found[\"file_name\"]) if stored else None\n   123\t\n   124\t\n   125\tdef pages() -> list[Page]:\n   126\t    \"\"\"Every page of the site: what `cms publish` writes.\"\"\"\n   127\t    return [home(), data_bite_list(), report_list(),\n   128\t            *map(_data_bite_page, data_bites.list_published()),\n   129\t            *map(_report_page, reports.list_published())]\n   130\t\n   131\t\n   132\tdef files() -> dict[str, Path]:\n   133\t    \"\"\"Every file the site's pages link to besides the stylesheet, as\n   134\t    {path in the site: where it is stored}: the published Reports' files.\"\"\"\n   135\t    stored = {found[\"slug\"]: _stored_file(found) for found in reports.list_published()}\n   136\t    return {report_file_path(slug): path for slug, path in stored.items() if path}\n=== app/publish.py\n     1\t\"\"\"`cms publish`: write the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n     2\t\n     3\tThe pages and files come from app.public_site, the same ones the app serves,\n     4\tat the same paths, so the export is the live public site rather than a second\n     5\trendering of it. That module reads only published content and links only\n     6\trelatively, which gives the two rules the rubric checks here:\n     7\t\n     8\t  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n     9\t  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"reports/x.html\"), never\n    10\t     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n    11\t\"\"\"\n    12\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    13\t\n    14\timport shutil\n    15\tfrom pathlib import Path\n    16\t\n    17\tfrom app import public_site, settings\n    18\t\n    19\t\n    20\tdef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    21\t    \"\"\"Regenerate `out` (site/ by default) from scratch, so a page taken down\n    22\t    since the last publish is gone from it too.\"\"\"\n    23\t    out = out or settings.SITE\n    24\t    if out.exists():\n    25\t        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    26\t    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    27\t    # UTF-8, as the app serves them, whatever this machine's locale.\n    28\t    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(public_site.CSS, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    29\t    for page in public_site.pages():\n    30\t        _target(out, page.path).write_text(page.render(), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    31\t    for path, stored in public_site.files().items():\n    32\t        shutil.copyfile(stored, _target(out, path))\n    33\t    return out\n    34\t\n    35\t\n    36\tdef _target(out: Path, path: str) -> Path:\n    37\t    \"\"\"Where `path` in the site goes under `out`, its folder made.\"\"\"\n    38\t    target = out / path\n    39\t    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    40\t    return target\n=== app/db.py\n     1\t\"\"\"SQLite access. Every table's schema lives here, so init_db() builds them all.\"\"\"\n     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     3\t\n     4\timport sqlite3\n     5\tfrom collections.abc import Iterator\n     6\tfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n     7\t\n     8\tfrom app import settings\n     9\t\n    10\tSCHEMA = \"\"\"\n    11\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    12\t    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    13\t    email         TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    14\t    name          TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    15\t    role          TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    16\t    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    17\t    is_active     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    18\t    created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n    19\t);\n    20\t\n    21\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_bites (\n    22\t    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    23\t    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    24\t    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    25\t    body       TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- raw Markdown; sanitized only when rendered\n    26\t    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    27\t    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    28\t    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    29\t    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n    30\t);\n    31\t\n    32\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reports (\n    33\t    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    34\t    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n    35\t    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- unique among Reports only; a Data Bite may share it\n    36\t    body       TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- raw Markdown; sanitized only when rendered\n    37\t    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    38\t    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    39\t    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    40\t    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    41\t    file_name  TEXT    -- the attached PDF's sanitized name for display; NULL if none\n    42\t);\n    43\t\"\"\"\n    44\t\n    45\t# Columns added after a table was first created: (table, column, definition).\n    46\t# CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves an existing table alone, so init_db adds\n    47\t# any of these an older database is missing.\n    48\tADDED_COLUMNS = [\n    49\t    (\"reports\", \"file_name\", \"TEXT\"),\n    50\t]\n    51\t\n    52\t\n    53\t@contextmanager\n    54\tdef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    55\t    \"\"\"Open the database named by settings (read at call time, so tests can swap\n    56\t    it). Commits on success, rolls back on error, always closes.\"\"\"\n    57\t    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n    58\t    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    59\t    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    60\t    try:\n    61\t        with conn:\n    62\t            yield conn\n    63\t    finally:\n    64\t        conn.close()\n    65\t\n    66\t\n    67\tdef init_db() -> None:\n    68\t    with connect() as conn:\n    69\t        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n    70\t        for table, column, definition in ADDED_COLUMNS:\n    71\t            existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n    72\t            if column not in existing:\n    73\t                conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {definition}\")\n=== app/content.py\n     1\t\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\n     2\tvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n     3\t\n     4\tEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\n     5\tData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\n     6\texports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\n     7\tmodule and routes, not here.\n     8\t\"\"\"\n     9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    10\t\n    11\timport re\n    12\timport sqlite3\n    13\tfrom collections.abc import Callable\n    14\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n    15\t\n    16\tfrom app import db\n    17\t\n    18\tSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n    19\t# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n    20\t# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\n    21\tAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n    22\t_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n    23\t# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n    24\t# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n    25\t_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n    26\t\n    27\t\n    28\tclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    29\t    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n    30\t\n    31\t\n    32\tclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    33\t    pass\n    34\t\n    35\t\n    36\tdef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    37\t    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    38\t    if not title:\n    39\t        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    40\t    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n    41\t        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n    42\t                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    43\t    if slug in _RESERVED_SLUGS:\n    44\t        raise ContentError(f\"The slug {slug} is reserved for the list page; \"\n    45\t                           \"choose another.\")\n    46\t    if not body.strip():\n    47\t        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    48\t    return title, slug, body\n    49\t\n    50\t\n    51\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n    52\tclass ContentTable:\n    53\t    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    54\t    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    55\t    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    56\t    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n    57\t\n    58\t    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    59\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n    60\t            return conn.execute(\n    61\t                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n    62\t                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n    63\t                params,\n    64\t            ).fetchall()\n    65\t\n    66\t    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n    67\t        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n    68\t        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n    69\t            raise exc\n    70\t        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n    71\t\n    72\t    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n    73\t               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n    74\t        \"\"\"Create a draft.\"\"\"\n    75\t        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n    76\t        try:\n    77\t            with db.connect() as conn:\n    78\t                item_id = conn.execute(\n    79\t                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id)\"\n    80\t                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n    81\t                    (title, slug, body, author_id),\n    82\t                ).lastrowid\n    83\t                if also:\n    84\t                    also(conn, item_id)\n    85\t        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n    86\t            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n    87\t        return item_id\n    88\t\n    89\t    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n    90\t               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n    91\t        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n    92\t        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. False if\n    93\t        nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n    94\t        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n    95\t        try:\n    96\t            with db.connect() as conn:\n    97\t                changed = conn.execute(\n    98\t                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n    99\t                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n   100\t                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n   101\t                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n   102\t                ).rowcount == 1\n   103\t                if changed and also:\n   104\t                    also(conn, item_id)\n   105\t                return changed\n   106\t        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n   107\t            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n   108\t\n   109\t    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n   110\t        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n   111\t        return rows[0] if rows else None\n   112\t\n   113\t    def list_all(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n   114\t        \"\"\"Every item, or only those in `status`; most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n   115\t        where, params = (\"1\", ()) if status is None else (\"c.status = ?\", (status,))\n   116\t        return self._select(where, \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\", params)\n   117\t\n   118\t    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n   119\t        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.\n   120\t        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"\n   121\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n   122\t            rows = conn.execute(\n   123\t                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n   124\t        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}\n   125\t\n   126\t    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n   127\t        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n   128\t\n   129\t    def get_published(self, slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n   130\t        \"\"\"The published item with this slug; None for a draft or no such item.\"\"\"\n   131\t        rows = self._select(\"c.status = 'published' AND c.slug = ?\", \"c.id\", (slug,))\n   132\t        return rows[0] if rows else None\n   133\t\n   134\t    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n   135\t        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n   136\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n   137\t            return conn.execute(\n   138\t                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n   139\t                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n   140\t                (status, item_id),\n   141\t            ).rowcount == 1\n   142\t\n   143\t    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n   144\t        \"\"\"False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n   145\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n   146\t            return conn.execute(\n   147\t                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n=== app/data_bites.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Data Bites: short, dated Markdown items.\n     2\t\n     3\tAny Analyst or Director may create, edit, publish, and unpublish any Data Bite\n     4\t(shift continuity, ADR-003); only a Director may delete one, which the routes\n     5\tenforce. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n     6\t\n     7\tPublic-facing code reads Data Bites only through `list_published` and\n     8\t`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n     9\t\"\"\"\n    10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    11\t\n    12\timport sqlite3\n    13\t\n    14\tfrom app.content import ContentTable\n    15\t\n    16\t_TABLE = ContentTable(\"data_bites\", \"Data Bite\")\n    17\t\n    18\tcreate = _TABLE.create\n    19\tget = _TABLE.get\n    20\tlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\n    21\tcount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\n    22\tset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n    23\tdelete = _TABLE.delete\n    24\tget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n    25\t\n    26\t\n    27\tdef update(bite_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> bool:\n    28\t    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    29\t    return _TABLE.update(bite_id, title, slug, body)\n    30\t\n    31\t\n    32\tdef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    33\t    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Data Bites only, newest first.\"\"\"\n    34\t    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n=== app/reports.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n     2\t\n     3\tAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\n     4\tdraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\n     5\tpublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\n     6\tstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\n     7\tDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n     8\t\n     9\tA Report may carry one attached PDF (checked by app.uploads). Attaching,\n    10\treplacing, or removing it follows the same lockdown as the body. The file is\n    11\tstored under settings.UPLOADS, outside site/, named by the Report's id; the\n    12\t`file_name` column says whether there is one.\n    13\t\n    14\tPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published` and\n    15\t`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n    16\t\"\"\"\n    17\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    18\t\n    19\timport os\n    20\timport sqlite3\n    21\timport tempfile\n    22\tfrom pathlib import Path\n    23\t\n    24\tfrom app import db, settings\n    25\tfrom app.content import AlsoWrite, ContentError, ContentTable\n    26\tfrom app.uploads import Pdf\n    27\tfrom app.users import is_director\n    28\t\n    29\t_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n    30\t\n    31\tget = _TABLE.get\n    32\tlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\n    33\tcount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\n    34\tset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n    35\tget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n    36\t\n    37\t\n    38\tclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n    39\t    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n    40\t\n    41\t\n    42\tdef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    43\t    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update` and `remove_file` apply the same rule in\n    44\t    their UPDATEs.\"\"\"\n    45\t    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n    46\t\n    47\t\n    48\tdef file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n    49\t    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. That module reads only published content and links only\n260\t     6\trelatively, which gives the two rules the rubric checks here:\n261\t     7\t\n262\t     8\t  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n263\t     9\t  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"reports/x.html\"), never\n264\t    10\t     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n265\t    11\t\"\"\"\n266\t    12\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n267\t    13\t\n268\t    14\timport shutil\n269\t    15\tfrom pathlib import Path\n270\t    16\t\n271\t    17\tfrom app import public_site, settings\n272\t    18\t\n273\t    19\t\n274\t    20\tdef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n275\t    21\t    \"\"\"Regenerate `out` (site/ by default) from scratch, so a page taken down\n276\t    22\t    since the last publish is gone from it too.\"\"\"\n277\t    23\t    out = out or settings.SITE\n278\t    24\t    if out.exists():\n279\t    25\t        shutil.rmtree(out)\n280\t    26\t    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n281\t    27\t    # UTF-8, as the app serves them, whatever this machine's locale.\n282\t    28\t    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(public_site.CSS, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n283\t    29\t    for page in public_site.pages():\n284\t    30\t        _target(out, page.path).write_text(page.render(), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n285\t    31\t    for path, stored in public_site.files().items():\n286\t    32\t        shutil.copyfile(stored, _target(out, path))\n287\t    33\t    return out\n288\t    34\t\n289\t    35\t\n290\t    36\tdef _target(out: Path, path: str) -> Path:\n291\t    37\t    \"\"\"Where `path` in the site goes under `out`, its folder made.\"\"\"\n292\t    38\t    target = out / path\n293\t    39\t    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n294\t    40\t    return target\n295\t=== app/db.py\n296\t     1\t\"\"\"SQLite access. Every table's schema lives here, so init_db() builds them all.\"\"\"\n297\t     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n298\t     3\t\n299\t     4\timport sqlite3\n300\t     5\tfrom collections.abc import Iterator\n301\t     6\tfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n302\t     7\t\n303\t     8\tfrom app import settings\n304\t     9\t\n305\t    10\tSCHEMA = \"\"\"\n306\t    11\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n307\t    12\t    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n308\t    13\t    email         TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n309\t    14\t    name          TEXT    NOT NULL,\n310\t    15\t    role          TEXT    NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n311\t    16\t    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,\n312\t    17\t    is_active     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n313\t    18\t    created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n314\t    19\t);\n315\t    20\t\n316\t    21\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS data_bites (\n317\t    22\t    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n318\t    23\t    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n319\t    24\t    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n320\t    25\t    body       TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- raw Markdown; sanitized only when rendered\n321\t    26\t    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n322\t    27\t    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n323\t    28\t    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n324\t    29\t    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n325\t    30\t);\n326\t    31\t\n327\t    32\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reports (\n328\t    33\t    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n329\t    34\t    title      TEXT    NOT NULL,\n330\t    35\t    slug       TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- unique among Reports only; a Data Bite may share it\n331\t    36\t    body       TEXT    NOT NULL,  -- raw Markdown; sanitized only when rendered\n332\t    37\t    status     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n333\t    38\t    author_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n334\t    39\t    created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n335\t    40\t    updated_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n336\t    41\t    file_name  TEXT    -- the attached PDF's sanitized name for display; NULL if none\n337\t    42\t);\n338\t    43\t\"\"\"\n339\t    44\t\n340\t    45\t# Columns added after a table was first created: (table, column, definition).\n341\t    46\t# CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves an existing table alone, so init_db adds\n342\t    47\t# any of these an older database is missing.\n343\t    48\tADDED_COLUMNS = [\n344\t    49\t    (\"reports\", \"file_name\", \"TEXT\"),\n345\t    50\t]\n346\t    51\t\n347\t    52\t\n348\t    53\t@contextmanager\n349\t    54\tdef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n350\t    55\t    \"\"\"Open the database named by settings (read at call time, so tests can swap\n351\t    56\t    it). Commits on success, rolls back on error, always closes.\"\"\"\n352\t    57\t    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.DATABASE_PATH)\n353\t    58\t    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n354\t    59\t    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n355\t    60\t    try:\n356\t    61\t        with conn:\n357\t    62\t            yield conn\n358\t    63\t    finally:\n359\t    64\t        conn.close()\n360\t    65\t\n361\t    66\t\n362\t    67\tdef init_db() -> None:\n363\t    68\t    with connect() as conn:\n364\t    69\t        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n365\t    70\t        for table, column, definition in ADDED_COLUMNS:\n366\t    71\t            existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n367\t    72\t            if column not in existing:\n368\t    73\t                conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {definition}\")\n369\t=== app/content.py\n370\t     1\t\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\n371\t     2\tvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n372\t     3\t\n373\t     4\tEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\n374\t     5\tData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\n375\t     6\texports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\n376\t     7\tmodule and routes, not here.\n377\t     8\t\"\"\"\n378\t     9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n379\t    10\t\n380\t    11\timport re\n381\t    12\timport sqlite3\n382\t    13\tfrom collections.abc import Callable\n383\t    14\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n384\t    15\t\n385\t    16\tfrom app import db\n386\t    17\t\n387\t    18\tSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n388\t    19\t# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n389\t    20\t# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\n390\t    21\tAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n391\t    22\t_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n392\t    23\t# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n393\t    24\t# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n394\t    25\t_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n395\t    26\t\n396\t    27\t\n397\t    28\tclass ContentError(ValueError):\n398\t    29\t    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n399\t    30\t\n400\t    31\t\n401\t    32\tclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n402\t    33\t    pass\n403\t    34\t\n404\t    35\t\n405\t    36\tdef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n406\t    37\t    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n407\t    38\t    if not title:\n408\t    39\t        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n409\t    40\t    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n410\t    41\t        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n411\t    42\t                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n412\t    43\t    if slug in _RESERVED_SLUGS:\n413\t    44\t        raise ContentError(f\"The slug {slug} is reserved for the list page; \"\n414\t    45\t                           \"choose another.\")\n415\t    46\t    if not body.strip():\n416\t    47\t        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n417\t    48\t    return title, slug, body\n418\t    49\t\n419\t    50\t\n420\t    51\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n421\t    52\tclass ContentTable:\n422\t    53\t    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n423\t    54\t    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n424\t    55\t    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n425\t    56\t    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n426\t    57\t\n427\t    58\t    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n428\t    59\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n429\t    60\t            return conn.execute(\n430\t    61\t                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n431\t    62\t                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n432\t    63\t                params,\n433\t    64\t            ).fetchall()\n434\t    65\t\n435\t    66\t    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n436\t    67\t        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n437\t    68\t        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n438\t    69\t            raise exc\n439\t    70\t        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n440\t    71\t\n441\t    72\t    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n442\t    73\t               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n443\t    74\t        \"\"\"Create a draft.\"\"\"\n444\t    75\t        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n445\t    76\t        try:\n446\t    77\t            with db.connect() as conn:\n447\t    78\t                item_id = conn.execute(\n448\t    79\t                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id)\"\n449\t    80\t                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n450\t    81\t                    (title, slug, body, author_id),\n451\t    82\t                ).lastrowid\n452\t    83\t                if also:\n453\t    84\t                    also(conn, item_id)\n454\t    85\t        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n455\t    86\t            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n456\t    87\t        return item_id\n457\t    88\t\n458\t    89\t    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n459\t    90\t               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n460\t    91\t        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n461\t    92\t        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. False if\n462\t    93\t        nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n463\t    94\t        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n464\t    95\t        try:\n465\t    96\t            with db.connect() as conn:\n466\t    97\t                changed = conn.execute(\n467\t    98\t                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n468\t    99\t                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n469\t   100\t                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n470\t   101\t                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n471\t   102\t                ).rowcount == 1\n472\t   103\t                if changed and also:\n473\t   104\t                    also(conn, item_id)\n474\t   105\t                return changed\n475\t   106\t        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n476\t   107\t            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n477\t   108\t\n478\t   109\t    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n479\t   110\t        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n480\t   111\t        return rows[0] if rows else None\n481\t   112\t\n482\t   113\t    def list_all(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n483\t   114\t        \"\"\"Every item, or only those in `status`; most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n484\t   115\t        where, params = (\"1\", ()) if status is None else (\"c.status = ?\", (status,))\n485\t   116\t        return self._select(where, \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\", params)\n486\t   117\t\n487\t   118\t    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n488\t   119\t        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.\n489\t   120\t        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"\n490\t   121\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n491\t   122\t            rows = conn.execute(\n492\t   123\t                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n493\t   124\t        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}\n494\t   125\t\n495\t   126\t    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n496\t   127\t        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n497\t   128\t\n498\t   129\t    def get_published(self, slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n499\t   130\t        \"\"\"The published item with this slug; None for a draft or no such item.\"\"\"\n500\t   131\t        rows = self._select(\"c.status = 'published' AND c.slug = ?\", \"c.id\", (slug,))\n501\t   132\t        return rows[0] if rows else None\n502\t   133\t\n503\t   134\t    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n504\t   135\t        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n505\t   136\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n506\t   137\t            return conn.execute(\n507\t   138\t                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n508\t   139\t                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n509\t   140\t                (status, item_id),\n510\t   141\t            ).rowcount == 1\n511\t   142\t\n512\t   143\t    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n513\t   144\t        \"\"\"False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n514\t   145\t        with db.connect() as conn:\n515\t   146\t            return conn.execute(\n516\t   147\t                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n517\t=== app/data_bites.py\n518\t     1\t\"\"\"Data Bites: short, dated Markdown items.\n519\t     2\t\n520\t     3\tAny Analyst or Director may create, edit, publish, and unpublish any Data Bite\n521\t     4\t(shift continuity, ADR-003); only a Director may delete one, which the routes\n522\t     5\tenforce. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n523\t     6\t\n524\t     7\tPublic-facing code reads Data Bites only through `list_published` and\n525\t     8\t`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n526\t     9\t\"\"\"\n527\t    10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n528\t    11\t\n529\t    12\timport sqlite3\n530\t    13\t\n531\t    14\tfrom app.content import ContentTable\n532\t    15\t\n533\t    16\t_TABLE = ContentTable(\"data_bites\", \"Data Bite\")\n534\t    17\t\n535\t    18\tcreate = _TABLE.create\n536\t    19\tget = _TABLE.get\n537\t    20\tlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\n538\t    21\tcount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\n539\t    22\tset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n540\t    23\tdelete = _TABLE.delete\n541\t    24\tget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n542\t    25\t\n543\t    26\t\n544\t    27\tdef update(bite_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> bool:\n545\t    28\t    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n546\t    29\t    return _TABLE.update(bite_id, title, slug, body)\n547\t    30\t\n548\t    31\t\n549\t    32\tdef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n550\t    33\t    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Data Bites only, newest first.\"\"\"\n551\t    34\t    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n552\t=== app/reports.py\n553\t     1\t\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n554\t     2\t\n555\t     3\tAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\n556\t     4\tdraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\n557\t     5\tpublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\n558\t     6\tstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\n559\t     7\tDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n560\t     8\t\n561\t     9\tA Report may carry one attached PDF (checked by app.uploads). Attaching,\n562\t    10\treplacing, or removing it follows the same lockdown as the body. The file is\n563\t    11\tstored under settings.UPLOADS, outside site/, named by the Report's id; the\n564\t    12\t`file_name` column says whether there is one.\n565\t    13\t\n566\t    14\tPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published` and\n567\t    15\t`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n568\t    16\t\"\"\"\n569\t    17\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n570\t    18\t\n571\t    19\timport os\n572\t    20\timport sqlite3\n573\t    21\timport tempfile\n574\t    22\tfrom pathlib import Path\n575\t    23\t\n576\t    24\tfrom app import db, settings\n577\t    25\tfrom app.content import AlsoWrite, ContentError, ContentTable\n578\t    26\tfrom app.uploads import Pdf\n579\t    27\tfrom app.users import is_director\n580\t    28\t\n581\t    29\t_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\")\n582\t    30\t\n583\t    31\tget = _TABLE.get\n584\t    32\tlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\n585\t    33\tcount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\n586\t    34\tset_status = _TABLE.set_status\n587\t    35\tget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n588\t    36\t\n589\t    37\t\n590\t    38\tclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n591\t    39\t    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n592\t    40\t\n593\t    41\t\n594\t    42\tdef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n595\t    43\t    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update` and `remove_file` apply the same rule in\n596\t    44\t    their UPDATEs.\"\"\"\n597\t    45\t    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n598\t    46\t\n599\t    47\t\n600\t    48\tdef file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n601\t    49\t    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. Built from the id alone.\"\"\"\n602\t    50\t    return settings.UPLOADS / \"reports\" / f\"{int(report_id)}.pdf\"\n603\t    51\t\n604\t    52\t\n605\t    53\tdef _write_atomically(path: Path, data: bytes) -> None:\n606\t    54\t    \"\"\"Replace `path` in one step, so a failed write never leaves half a file.\"\"\"\n607\t    55\t    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n608\t    56\t    fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=path.parent, suffix=\".part\")\n609\t    57\t    try:\n610\t    58\t        with os.fdopen(fd, \"wb\") as f:\n611\t    59\t            f.write(data)\n612\t    60\t        os.replace(tmp, path)\n613\t    61\t    except BaseException:\n614\t    62\t        Path(tmp).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n615\t    63\t        raise\n616\t    64\t\n617\t    65\t\n618\t    66\tdef _attaching(pdf: Pdf | None) -> AlsoWrite | None:\n619\t    67\t    \"\"\"Attach `pdf` in the same transaction as the Report's row, so the body\n620\t    68\t    and the file are saved together or not at all.\"\"\"\n621\t    69\t    if pdf is None:\n622\t    70\t        return None\n623\t    71\t\n624\t    72\t    def attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n625\t    73\t        conn.execute(\"UPDATE reports SET file_name = ? WHERE id = ?\", (pdf.name, report_id))\n626\t    74\t        _write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n627\t    75\t\n628\t    76\t    return attach\n629\t    77\t\n630\t    78\t\n631\t    79\tdef _missing_or_locked(report_id: int) -> bool:\n632\t    80\t    \"\"\"After a guarded write changed nothing: False if there is no such\n633\t    81\t    Report, otherwise it was published and locked.\"\"\"\n634\t    82\t    if get(report_id) is None:\n635\t    83\t        return False\n636\t    84\t    raise ReportLocked(\"Only the Director can change a published Report.\")\n637\t    85\t\n638\t    86\t\n639\t    87\tdef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n640\t    88\t           pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> int:\n641\t    89\t    \"\"\"Create a draft Report, with its file if one is given.\"\"\"\n642\t    90\t    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id, also=_attaching(pdf))\n643\t    91\t\n644\t    92\t\n645\t    93\tdef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n646\t    94\t           user: sqlite3.Row, pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> bool:\n647\t    95\t    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`, and attach or replace\n648\t    96\t    the file if one is given. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked if\n649\t    97\t    it is published and `user` is not a Director.\"\"\"\n650\t    98\t    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n651\t    99\t                     also=_attaching(pdf)):\n652\t   100\t        return True\n653\t   101\t    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n654\t   102\t\n655\t   103\t\n656\t   104\tdef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n657\t   105\t    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file on behalf of `user`, as `update`.\"\"\"\n658\t   106\t    with db.connect() as conn:\n659\t   107\t        removed = conn.execute(\n660\t   108\t            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n661\t   109\t            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR ?)\",\n662\t   110\t            (report_id, is_director(user)),\n663\t   111\t        ).rowcount == 1\n664\t   112\t    if not removed:\n665\t   113\t        return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n666\t   114\t    # Only once the row no longer names it, so a failed commit keeps the file.\n667\t   115\t    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n668\t   116\t    return True\n669\t   117\t\n670\t   118\t\n671\t   119\tdef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n672\t   120\t    \"\"\"Delete the Report and its file. False if there is no such Report.\"\"\"\n673\t   121\t    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n674\t   122\t        return False\n675\t   123\t    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n676\t   124\t    return True\n677\t   125\t\n678\t   126\t\n679\t   127\tdef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n680\t   128\t    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n681\t   129\t    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")\n682\t=== app/settings.py\n683\t     1\t\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\n684\t     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n685\t     3\t\n686\t     4\timport os\n687\t     5\tfrom pathlib import Path\n688\t     6\t\n689\t     7\tROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n690\t     8\t\n691\t     9\t\n692\t    10\tdef _load_dotenv(path: Path) -> None:\n693\t    11\t    \"\"\"Read KEY=VALUE lines from .env into os.environ. Variables already set in\n694\t    12\t    the real environment win.\"\"\"\n695\t    13\t    if not path.is_file():\n696\t    14\t        return\n697\t    15\t    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():\n698\t    16\t        key, sep, value = line.partition(\"=\")\n699\t    17\t        key = key.strip()\n700\t    18\t        if not sep or not key or key.startswith(\"#\"):\n701\t    19\t            continue\n702\t    20\t        os.environ.setdefault(key, value.strip().strip(\"'\\\"\"))\n703\t    21\t\n704\t    22\t\n705\t    23\t_load_dotenv(ROOT / \".env\")\n706\t    24\t\n707\t    25\tTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\n708\t    26\tSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n709\t    27\t\n710\t    28\tSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\n711\t    29\tSECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER = SECRET_KEY in (\n712\t    30\t    \"dev-only-not-for-production\", \"[REDACTED]\")\n713\t    31\t# A relative CMS_DATABASE is relative to the repo, not the current directory.\n714\t    32\tDATABASE_PATH = ROOT / os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", \"cms.db\")\n715\t    33\t# Uploaded Report files. Outside site/, and gitignored like the database.\n716\t    34\tUPLOADS = ROOT / os.environ.get(\"CMS_UPLOADS\", \"uploads\")\n717\t    35\tSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n718\t    36\t# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n719\t    37\t# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\n720\t    38\tBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n721\t=== app/main.py\n722\t     1\t\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n723\t     2\t\n724\t     3\tThe admin console lives under /admin (login required) and the public site\n725\t     4\tat /. Keep this file small.\n727\t     6\t\"\"\"\n728\t     7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n729\t     8\t\n730\t     9\timport sys\n731\t    10\tfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\n732\t    11\t\n733\t    12\tfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Request\n734\t    13\tfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n735\t    14\tfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n736\t    15\t\n737\t    16\tfrom app import db, settings\n738\t    17\tfrom app.auth import LoginRequired, current_user\n739\t    18\tfrom app.routes import admin, auth, data_bites, public, reports, users\n740\t    19\t\n741\t    20\tSESSION_MAX_AGE = 8 * 60 * 60  # one working day\n742\t    21\tALL_METHODS = [\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\", \"OPTIONS\"]\n743\t    22\t\n744\t    23\t\n745\t    24\t@asynccontextmanager\n746\t    25\tasync def lifespan(app: FastAPI):\n747\t    26\t    # At server start, not import, so importing app.main never touches a database.\n748\t    27\t    db.init_db()\n749\t    28\t    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER:\n750\t    29\t        print(\"WARNING: CMS_SECRET_KEY is unset or the .env.example placeholder; \"\n751\t    30\t              \"session cookies can be forged. Set a long random value in .env.\",\n752\t    31\t              file=sys.stderr)\n753\t    32\t    yield\n754\t    33\t\n755\t    34\t\n756\t    35\tdef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n757\t    36\t    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", lifespan=lifespan)\n758\t    37\t    app.add_middleware(\n759\t    38\t        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n760\t    39\t        session_cookie=\"cms_session\", max_age=SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\",\n761\t    40\t    )\n762\t    41\t\n763\t    42\t    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n764\t    43\t    def redirect_to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n765\t    44\t        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n766\t    45\t\n767\t    46\t    app.include_router(public.router)\n768\t    47\t    app.include_router(auth.router)\n769\t    48\t    app.include_router(admin.router)\n770\t    49\t    app.include_router(users.router)\n771\t    50\t    app.include_router(data_bites.router)\n772\t    51\t    app.include_router(reports.router)\n773\t    52\t\n774\t    53\t    # Must stay last: any /admin request no router above claimed, by path or by\n775\t    54\t    # method. Anonymous visitors are sent to login (so they can't probe which\n776\t    55\t    # admin paths exist); signed-in users get 405/404.\n777\t    56\t    @app.api_route(\"/admin\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n778\t    57\t                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n779\t    58\t    def admin_method_not_allowed():\n780\t    59\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=405)\n781\t    60\t\n782\t    61\t    @app.api_route(\"/admin/{rest:path}\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n783\t    62\t                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n784\t    63\t    def admin_not_found(rest: str):\n785\t    64\t        if rest == \"\":\n786\t    65\t            return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=307)\n787\t    66\t        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n788\t    67\t\n789\t    68\t    return app\n790\t    69\t\n791\t    70\t\n792\t    71\tapp = create_app()\n793\t=== app/templating.py\n794\t
